step1_feature_extraction.notes: Compositional features (7 cols) for all 679 experimental samples

step2_model_training.notes: GPR + RF; 5-fold CV R^2 > 0.60 on 679 samples (not Zr-filtered)

step3a_candidate_generation.notes: Stochastic charge-balanced virtual library; up to 20,000 requested, 14,474 unique passed charge balance

step3b_compositional_screening.notes: RF trained on garnet-Zr-filtered subset; selects top 50 by predicted log-sigma

step3c_chgnet_evaluation.notes: 36/50 succeeded. CIF count is 41 (includes 3 legacy baseline structures + 2 novel candidates run separately). Several CIFs have corrupted volumes (vol/atom > 16 A^3) — see geometry_issues below.

geometry_issues.description: Structures with relaxed_volume_per_atom outside garnet-valid range 10-16 A^3
geometry_issues.cause: Staged relaxation with steps=10/5 insufficient for some substituted cells
geometry_issues.fix: Re-run evaluate_candidates_chgnet.py with steps=50/25 and fmax=0.1

step4a_thermodynamic_stability.notes: Requires $env:MP_API_KEY. Script ran successfully but returned 0 rows because API key was not set.

step4b_dynamical_stability.notes: Both rows are exception-fallback sentinels (inf imaginary freq). OOM on local machine. HPC required (~16 GB RAM, ~15 min/candidate).

step4c_mechanical_stability.notes: All 3 rows are exception-fallback sentinels (0/0/0 bulk/shear/Poisson). Bare-except swallows real error. HPC required.

step5_md_validation.notes: Geometry sanity check (vol/atom in 10-16 A^3) blocks corrupted structures from MD. Pre-requisite: fix step3c geometry failures, then set FAST_MODE=False and run on HPC.

step4_chgnet_validation.notes: 5 candidates passed CHGNet static + GPR screening. All thermally stable (delta_E < LLZO). GPR sigma ~5-7e-4 S/cm (10^-4 order).

step6_md_validation.notes: Same geometry-fix prerequisite as standard pipeline step5.

EarthAbundantPipeline_ea_validated_candi.notes: Best available EA result — CHGNet static + GPR predictions, all thermally stable

StandardPipeline_evaluated_top_candidate.notes: Real CHGNet output. Some rows have corrupted vol/atom (see geometry_issues in manifest). relaxed_cif_path column uses relative paths.

StandardPipeline_finalresults.csv.notes: MD validation pending geometry fix + HPC run

StandardPipeline_mechanical_stability.cs.notes: All 0/0/0 — bare-except fallback values, not real elastic tensor results

StandardPipeline_dynamical_stability.csv.notes: Both inf — phonon calc crashed, bare-except fallback
